title: Pump P-102 failure report
text: Pump P-102 failed on 12 March because the mechanical seal wore out after prolonged dry running. The seal had not been replaced since installation.

title: June maintenance log
text: Routine maintenance was performed in June on all centrifugal pumps. Lubrication levels were checked and two couplings were realigned.

title: Alarm event 7741
text: Alarm 7741 was triggered by a pressure spike in line L-3 following a rapid valve closure. The spike exceeded the 16 bar threshold for four seconds.

title: Compressor C-2 inspection
text: The quarterly inspection of compressor C-2 found no anomalies. Vibration readings stayed within tolerance across all measurement points.

title: Seal replacement procedure
text: Mechanical seal replacement requires draining the casing, removing the coupling guard, and verifying shaft runout before installing the new seal.

title: Operator note
text: Night shift reported intermittent noise near the discharge line of pump P-102 two weeks before the failure. No work order was raised at the time.
